title: Databricks SDK models artifact repo workspace client: resolve host/token from the registry URI before falling back to default auth, for serverless/SEG executors
answers: Loading a UC model on serverless or internet-restricted compute fails with a 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials' error; how is the workspace client built?
Which registry URI is passed to the Files API client when loading versus registering a UC model?
Where are Databricks host and token resolved for the Files API model artifact client?
body:
Path: mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:_get_databricks_workspace_client builds the databricks.sdk WorkspaceClient used by DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository for UC model load and register. It takes an optional registry_uri.
Rule: Resolve host and token with mlflow/utils/databricks_utils.py:get_databricks_host_creds(registry_uri) and build WorkspaceClient(host=..., token=...) when both are present. If resolution raises or returns no usable creds, log at debug and fall back to a bare WorkspaceClient() (default auth). The caller must pass registry_uri: UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository passes its registry_uri on load, and UcModelRegistryStore passes store_uri on register.
Symptom: On serverless or SEG compute, Spark executors lack default Databricks credentials, so a bare WorkspaceClient() failed with 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials'.
Constraints: Classic compute where default auth works still gets the default-auth path. Passing registry_uri is required for the resolved-creds path; without it the repo falls back to default auth.
applies: Creating or changing the Databricks client used for UC model file transfers, including when a new code path builds DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository.
says: Loading a catalog model on serverless compute fails with a default credentials error.
Model loading on secure executor clusters crashes because credentials cannot be found.
Unable to download model artifacts when running inference on serverless compute.
Model registration fails on restricted compute environments because workspace authentication was not found.
Allow serverless compute jobs to load models from the catalog using registry credentials.
search: The Databricks SDK workspace client in mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:_get_databricks_workspace_client resolves host and token from the registry URI before falling back to default auth. Host and credentials resolved via mlflow/utils/databricks_utils.py:get_databricks_host_creds(registry_uri) instantiate WorkspaceClient(host=..., token=...), falling back to bare WorkspaceClient() on error or missing credentials. Callers must supply registry_uri (such as UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository passing registry_uri on load and UcModelRegistryStore passing store_uri on register) to prevent 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials' failures on serverless or SEG compute executors lacking default credentials. Classic compute retaining functioning default credentials remains unaffected, but omitting registry_uri always falls back to default auth.
